title.en: Analyze Women's Exposure to Climate Hazards
title.fr: Analyser l'exposition des femmes aux aléas climatiques

imageAlt.en: A farmer inspects a dried maize cob in a highland maize field.
imageAlt.fr: Une agricultrice examine un épi de maïs sec dans un champ de maïs d'altitude.

description: See where climate risks disproportionately affect women in African agriculture and how exposure and empowerment differ across crops, countries, and regions.
